# Ontario Furnace Rebates

> Ontario Furnace Rebates helps Ontario homeowners book furnace, heat pump and AC service, compare upgrade options, and understand rebate guidance.

Ontario Furnace Rebates is an Ontario HVAC service website for homeowners looking for furnace repair or installation, heat pump service, air conditioning service, retrofit guidance, and home energy rebate information.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/): HVAC service, furnace and heat pump upgrade guidance, and rebate information for Ontario homeowners.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ontariofurnacerebates.ca/privacy.html): How Ontario Furnace Rebates handles information submitted through the quote form.

## Core Topics

- Furnace repair and installation in Ontario
- Heat pump installation and service
- Air conditioning repair and installation
- HVAC retrofits and home efficiency upgrades
- Furnace, heat pump and home energy rebate guidance
